install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends code=$INGLENOOK_VERSION jq xz-utils fonts-ibm-plex
npm install -g @vscode/vsce@4.1.1 && npm config set --location=global update-notifier false
apply: mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/Code/User" && jq -n --arg font "'IBM Plex Mono'" --arg term "'BlexMono Nerd Font Mono'" --arg theme "$(jq -r '.contributes.themes[0].label' Ports/vscode/dist/$INGLENOOK_VARIANT/package.json)" '{"editor.fontFamily": $font, "terminal.integrated.fontFamily": $term, "workbench.colorTheme": $theme}' > "$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"
stage: s="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; jq '. + {"update.mode": "none", "extensions.autoUpdate": false, "extensions.autoCheckUpdates": false, "extensions.ignoreRecommendations": true, "telemetry.telemetryLevel": "off", "workbench.enableExperiments": false, "workbench.startupEditor": "none", "workbench.tips.enabled": false, "security.workspace.trust.enabled": false, "chat.disableAIFeatures": true, "workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility": "hidden", "git.autofetch": false, "editor.cursorBlinking": "solid", "editor.fontSize": 16}' "$s" > "$s.new" && mv "$s.new" "$s"
